title: Okelan County's 2027 felony probation revocation admissions and violator pods under SB 26-118
setting: A fictional county in an unnamed state on Central time, whose Adult Probation Department supervises felony and misdemeanor probationers and whose Detention Center houses felony revocation commitments under the State's 2019 realignment; a statute caps felony supervision at 24 months from 1 January 2027. The county, its bodies, its statute and its people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
